As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen . The move comes just months after Tidal began labeling and demonetizing tracks identified as 100 percent AI-generated. In a post on X, Andersen says Tidal needed to take a more "drastic" measure, as AI music made up 43 percent of the tracks distributed to the platform in the last 90 days. There are sales happening for both the ad-supported and ad-free tiers that offer full access to both services, and either will save you quite a bit of money. For those who despise ads, you can opt for the ad-free version for $14.99 per month (was $21.99) for a year, costing you $180 instead of $264 over the duration. This deal is located in a small banner near the bottom of the sale page via Hulu or Disney Plus . The ad-supported tier drops from $12.99 to just $4.99, so you’ll pay $60 over the course of the year instead of $156. You have through Cyber Monday, November 30th, at 11:59PM PST to take advantage of the lower prices. Disney Plus, Hulu Bundle Where to Buy: $12.99 $4.99 at Hulu (ad-supported, monthly) $21.99 $14.99 at Hulu (ad-free, monthly) The Hulu and Disney Plus bundle is one of the best values in streaming, especially if you have kids who can’t get enough Disney movies and other cartoons. On the other hand, Hulu is home to plenty of shows made for adults, including Furious (a crime drama that gripped this household like no other show this year), The Bear , Shōgun , Alien: Earth , The Lowdown , and many more. It’s worth the subscription just for those alone. The bundle includes Star Wars and Marvel content plus fun, uplifting shows to dig into over the holidays, like Bob’s Burgers , Futurama , The Simpsons , and It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia , to name some mainstays that tend to attract subscribers. If you’re considering other subscription services, we covered discounts on Paramount Plus (I might snag this to watch Cupertino ), HBO Max , and Peacock . But did you know the company still makes them? After selling steadily for $300 for several years and then spiking to $330 in recent months, the last-gen version of the iconic transparent speaker system is available for an all-time low of $149.99 from Harman Kardon , or $199.95 on Amazon . The discount puts them within range of most other desktop speakers you might consider sticking, or displaying, in your lounge area. Harman Kardon SoundSticks 4 audio system Where to Buy: $300 $199.99 at Amazon $300 $199.99 at Best Buy $300 $149.99 at Harman Kardon In addition to 3.5mm aux connectivity, the SoundSticks 4 support Bluetooth audio. The 2.1-channel system features two wired satellite speakers, each containing four drivers, and a powerful subwoofer encapsulated in a see-through dome. You can adjust the system’s volume by tapping the touch-sensitive plus or minus sections flanking the logo on the subwoofer. That’s not ideal if your plan was to hide the sub from sight, but I’d argue that most people interested in this model likely plan to showcase it on a shelf instead of tuck it away.
